summary: Quartz Mountain Resources Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing adoption of semi-annual financial reporting (SAR) under Coordinated Blanket Order 51-933. The company will cease filing interim quarterly reports for first and third quarters, while continuing annual and six-month filings. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, or other special-situation event is disclosed. The filing is a routine regulatory reporting change with no deal terms. No price, premium, dates, or advisors are mentioned. The registrant is a foreign private issuer making a standard reporting election.
